provenance.row_source_field: Every row carries a 'source' field: 'factpack_r100_section_5' means the numbers are printed in that fact pack section; 'composed_for_test' means WE invented the row to exercise a code path and it is NOT mined data.
provenance.drops_activity_deliberately_absent: DROPS_ACTIVITY (003, 4 rows) is published in the same fact pack section but is NOT carried here: this checkpoint does not implement event-time bonus layering, so carrying its rows would imply support that does not exist.
provenance.drops_quest_deliberately_absent: DROPS_QUEST (096) is NOT carried and NOT implemented. The fact pack proves only 311 of 2478 referenced quest sets exist client-side, so a quest roll would be invention. The roller refuses it by name.
provenance.nonclaim: This file is a documented excerpt for tests, not the shipped tables, and the roller that reads it is OUR reconstruction. The original server's roll order and RNG are unrecoverable forever.

DROPS_NORMAL.note: Fact pack: 'Row n_ID=1: item0(money) rate 100 min 15 max 25; money rate 50 min 5 max 10; money rate 20 min 5 max 10.' Three money slots; the shipped row has 30 slot columns and the remaining 27 are padding.

Fact pack: 'Row n_ID=1001 (used by Port Royal hostiles via 2701001): 2400046 (consumable 46) 30 pct x1; 2400047 15 pct x1; 2600701 (misc 701) 0.5 pct x1; 2600751 0.5 pct x1; money 1 pct x1.' 'x1' is read as n_MIN=n_MAX=1.

COMPOSED, NOT MINED. Slot 0 carries item prefix 23, which is not one of the four item-category prefixes, so the roller must refuse it by name. Slot 1 is a padding slot (item 0, rate 0, min 0, max 0) and must be skipped without a draw and without a refusal.

COMPOSED, NOT MINED. The rate-boundary and quantity-clamp bench: a 0 pct slot that must never drop, a 100 pct slot that must always drop, and a fractional 0.5 pct slot whose threshold is exactly 0.005 with a five-wide quantity span.

DROPS_EQUIPMENT.note: Fact pack: 'Row n_ID=1: rate 50 pct, 1 item, 15 equipment entries (2200201, 2200401, ... all EQUIPMENT_BASE refs) weight 100 each.' TRUNCATED EXCERPT: the shipped row carries 15 entries; the fact pack prints only the first two ids, so only those two are carried here. Rolling this row here is NOT rolling the shipped row.

COMPOSED, NOT MINED. Unequal weights (1 and 3, total 4) so a test can enumerate the exact cumulative boundary at 0.25, a rate of 100 pct so the gate always opens, and a fixed count of 2 so the multi-pick path runs.
COMPOSED, NOT MINED. Every weight is zero, so the weighted walk has no positive total and must refuse by name instead of picking entry 0 by accident.

DROPS_SPECIALLY.note: Fact pack: 'Row n_ID=1: rate 100 pct, 1-3 items, 2600041 w15 / 2600042 w40 / 2600043 w45.' Weights total 100, so the cumulative boundaries are 0.15 and 0.55.
